levels.text: Trace each reported issue from the URL to the code: urls.py names the view, and the view calls into pagination.py, services.py, and cache.py.
QuerySet methods return a new queryset; they never change the one they are called on. And look at what paginate() does with a value that is missing or not a number.
services.py holds three of the five: how quantity is parsed, what the seat check compares against, and what a booking forgets to do that PATCH remembers.
